description: This file defines a custom exception class 'NormalizeException' for the OrangeHRM project. It extends the base Exception class and provides static methods for specific error conditions related to normalization processes within the API serializer module.

classes.name: NormalizeException
classes.description: A custom exception class used within the API serializer to indicate normalization errors, with static methods for common error scenarios.

methods.name: notSetRequiredAttributes
methods.description: Returns a 'NormalizeException' indicating that required model attributes are not set.

methods.name: unsupportedType
methods.description: Returns a 'NormalizeException' indicating that an object is of an unsupported type, with details about the expected and actual type.
